items.title: 8.4 Do tabee halaton ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.4, printed pages 170-171.

blocks.title: Dynamic equilibrium
blocks.text: Dynamic equilibrium reversible amal mein woh halat hai jahan ek simt mein tabdeeli ki rate mukhalif simt mein tabdeeli ki rate ke barabar ho: agarche tabdeeliyan hoti rehti hain, poore system mein koi kul tabdeeli nazar nahi aati.

Reversible phase tabdeeli bhi do tabee halaton ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium deti hai: 0 degrees C par barf aur pani saath maujood hain, pani barf mein aur barf wapas pani mein ek hi rate se badalti hui.

Jab liquid band bartan mein rakha jaye to satah ke qareeb kuch liquid molecules ke paas gas phase mein bhaagne ki kaafi energy hoti hai, evaporation; jaise zyada molecules bhaagte hain, deewaron par gas ka dabao barhta hai. Ek hi waqt bukharat ke molecules liquid ki satah se takrate aur dobara pakre jate hain, condensation. Jaise dono amal jari rehte hain un ki rates barabar ho jati hain aur dynamic equilibrium pohnchta hai: gas banne wale liquid molecules ki tadaad liquid mein wapas aane wale gas molecules ke barabar hai, aur kisi darja hararat par vapour pressure mustaqil rehta hai jab tak system ko chhera na jaye. Darja hararat barhane se liquid molecules ki ausat kinetic energy barhti hai, to evaporation tez hoti hai aur vapour pressure barhta hai; condensation bhi tez hoti hai, aur zyada equilibrium vapour pressure ke saath naya dynamic equilibrium pohnchta hai. Vapour pressure ke lihaz se dynamic equilibrium woh halat hai jahan evaporation aur condensation ki rates barabar hon.

Band bartan mein liquid aur bukharat

blocks.prompt: Daleel dein ke 100 degrees C par pani aur us ke bukharat ke darmiyan, aur 0 degrees C par barf aur pani ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium maujood hai.
blocks.explanation: 100 degrees C par band bartan mein pani barabar rates se evaporate aur us ke bukharat condense hote hain, to vapour pressure 1 atm par rehta hai jabke molecules satah ko dono taraf paar karte rehte hain: dynamic equilibrium. 0 degrees C par barf pighalti aur pani ek hi rate se jamta hai, to barf aur pani ki miqdarein mustaqil rehti hain agarche alag alag molecules halat badalte rehte hain; yeh bhi dynamic hai.

items: Dynamic equilibrium: barabar rates se mukhalif tabdeeliyan, koi kul tabdeeli nahi; 0 degrees C par barf aur pani; band bartan mein liquid aur bukharat, jahan evaporation condensation ke barabar aur vapour pressure mustaqil hai, zyada darja hararat par nayi equilibrium qeemat tak barhta hua.
